hook.name: BlueHook
hook.description: Charges a 3% fee on every swap, taking it from the output token (BLUE on buys, ETH on sells). Fees are split 70% to weighted BLUE token holders (weight = balance × a time-based hold multiplier capped at 2×) and 30% to a restore stream for addresses holding ≥100 BLUE. A permissioned sweepFees function lets the launcher drain all accumulated ETH and BLUE from the contract.
